what_this_proves: That two parties who provisioned the same profile through different channels compute the same profile_hash. The hash is over the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization of the PARSED profile document, never over file bytes — formatting, key order, and trailing newlines do not change it.
rules: Parse the profile JSON, serialize with RFC 8785 JCS (UTF-8, sorted keys, no whitespace, shortest numbers), sha256 the bytes, write as "sha256:" + 64 lowercase hex.
The profile_id in the mandate request names which profile; profile_hash names which bytes. Both parties MUST agree on both or refuse (PROFILE_HASH_MISMATCH).

cases.note: The published charge@0.5 profile. Re-indent the file, reorder its keys, or strip its trailing newline and the hash MUST NOT change.
